sourceMethod.candidateConstraint: authorized SHA and tree equal the selected Production branch head immediately before the single initial Deploy action
sourceMethod.connectionTriggeredDeploymentDisposition: The connection is the single authorized bootstrap action only when protection, Production target, exact SHA/tree, project, and configuration are already bound; otherwise stop before connecting.
sourceMethod.postBootstrapGitState: connected only with git.deploymentEnabled=false verified effective; no test push, PR, branch tracking event, or merge

productionBootstrapPolicy.deploymentProtection: All Deployments with Vercel Authentication, established through a team default before project creation where available and verified on the exact project before the first deployment
productionBootstrapPolicy.productionInfrastructureBoundary: Only the minimum empty, isolated Production infrastructure required for a coherent protected build
orderedBootstrapSteps: configure required Production-target variables and secrets
provision a dedicated empty Production Supabase project only if required
establish exact Production project, Supabase, and origin bindings
perform the mandatory first Vercel Production deployment
verify automatic Git-triggered deployments are disabled
productionSupabaseRequirements: empty/no real beta-user dataset at bootstrap
RLS/grant contract, including explicit Data API grants where current project settings require them
Production Auth URL configuration limited to the protected bootstrap origin
bootstrapSmokeAllowed: Production environment and Supabase identities agree
bootstrapSmokeProhibited: execute the full E1-E5 acceptance journey

environmentVariables.name: APP_ENVIRONMENT
environmentVariables.purpose: Authoritative application security-environment identity; never inferred from a host, branch, URL, or request.
environmentVariables.rotation: Change only through reviewed environment rebinding; redeploy required.

environmentVariables.name: DEPLOYMENT_CLASS
environmentVariables.purpose: Classifies a hosted deployment as PREVIEW, STAGING, PRODUCTION_BOOTSTRAP_ONLY, or PRODUCTION_RELEASE without granting authority to execute it.
environmentVariables.sourceBoundary: Explicit environment-scoped metadata checked against APP_ENVIRONMENT and the deployment evidence authorization.
environmentVariables.rotation: Change only for an exact separately authorized action; a new Production release cannot reuse the bootstrap classification.

environmentVariables.name: SUPABASE_ENVIRONMENT
environmentVariables.purpose: Declares the logical Supabase target class and must match APP_ENVIRONMENT compatibility rules.
environmentVariables.rotation: Change only with an authorized target rebind; redeploy required.

environmentVariables.name: SUPABASE_PROJECT_REF
environmentVariables.purpose: Binds the declared target to the project reference encoded by the public Supabase URL.
environmentVariables.sourceBoundary: Explicit non-secret target metadata; use local for loopback Supabase.
environmentVariables.rotation: Change only with an authorized project rebind; redeploy required.

environmentVariables.name: PREVIEW_SUPABASE_PROJECT_REF
environmentVariables.purpose: Non-secret registry identity for the isolated Preview Supabase project; required by PREVIEW and PRODUCTION_RELEASE and validated whenever supplied elsewhere.
environmentVariables.sourceBoundary: Explicit environment-scoped metadata; never populated with a credential.
environmentVariables.rotation: Change only when the Preview Supabase project is separately reauthorized and rebound.

environmentVariables.name: STAGING_SUPABASE_PROJECT_REF
environmentVariables.purpose: Non-secret registry identity for the isolated staging Supabase project; required by STAGING and PRODUCTION_RELEASE and validated whenever supplied elsewhere.
environmentVariables.sourceBoundary: Explicit environment-scoped metadata; never populated with a credential.
environmentVariables.rotation: Change only when the staging Supabase project is separately reauthorized and rebound.

environmentVariables.name: PRODUCTION_SUPABASE_PROJECT_REF
environmentVariables.purpose: Non-secret comparison identity used to prohibit non-production deployments from silently using Production data.
environmentVariables.sourceBoundary: Explicit environment-scoped metadata; never populated with a credential.
environmentVariables.rotation: Change only when the Production Supabase project is separately reauthorized and rebound.

environmentVariables.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL
environmentVariables.purpose: Public Supabase API endpoint used by browser and server session clients.
environmentVariables.sourceBoundary: Local CLI output or environment-scoped hosted Supabase project metadata.
environmentVariables.rotation: Rebind and redeploy when the project endpoint changes.

environmentVariables.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY
environmentVariables.purpose: Browser-safe publishable Supabase API key; never a secret or service-role key.
environmentVariables.sourceBoundary: Local CLI output or environment-scoped hosted Supabase publishable-key metadata.
environmentVariables.rotation: Rotate under Supabase key policy and redeploy every bound application target.

environmentVariables.name: APP_ORIGIN
environmentVariables.purpose: Canonical absolute application origin for trusted Auth callbacks and same-origin checks.
environmentVariables.sourceBoundary: Environment-scoped canonical origin; never derived from request Host or caller input.
environmentVariables.rotation: Update only with reviewed origin/Auth allow-list binding; redeploy required.

environmentVariables.name: PREVIEW_APP_ORIGIN
environmentVariables.purpose: Trusted exact Preview deployment origin registry entry; required by PREVIEW and PRODUCTION_RELEASE, validated whenever supplied, and matched to VERCEL_URL when Preview is active.
environmentVariables.sourceBoundary: Reviewed environment metadata plus the provider-supplied exact generated deployment URL.
environmentVariables.rotation: Rebind for each exact Preview deployment used as APP_ORIGIN; redeploy and review Auth configuration.

environmentVariables.name: STAGING_APP_ORIGIN
environmentVariables.purpose: Trusted persistent staging origin registry entry; required by STAGING and PRODUCTION_RELEASE, validated whenever supplied, and matched to VERCEL_BRANCH_URL when staging is active.
environmentVariables.sourceBoundary: Reviewed staging target metadata plus the provider-supplied Git branch URL.
environmentVariables.rotation: Change only with an authorized staging origin rebind and Auth allow-list review.

environmentVariables.name: PRODUCTION_APP_ORIGIN
environmentVariables.purpose: Trusted Production origin registry entry; the bootstrap uses only the provider-owned project Production URL.
environmentVariables.sourceBoundary: Reviewed Production target metadata plus VERCEL_PROJECT_PRODUCTION_URL.
